query_plan.query: Which country has the largest population among countries with a life expectancy above 80 years?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by country, return the country with the maximum population.
steps.query: Return all countries with their population if the live expectancy in that country is above 80 years.

extra.sql_query: SELECT countries.name FROM countries WHERE countries.life_expectancy > 80 AND countries.population = ( SELECT MAX(countries.population) FROM countries WHERE countries.life_expectancy > 80 )

s1.sql_query: SELECT countries.name, countries.population FROM countries WHERE countries.life_expectancy > 80
